# Golden: the field set a user is allowed to see at a PROPOSE approval gate.
#
# WHAT THIS IS: a drift detector for the layer-1 output contract. It pins the FIELD SET, not the
# behaviour. Nothing here proves a real run is short — no test in this repo can, because neither
# test image ships a `claude` CLI and the repo mounts read-only.
#
# Re-recording: this file is hand-maintained. If you intentionally change the layer-1 contract in
#   commands/v-work/steps/03-propose.md      ("Required output — two layers")
#   commands/v-team/steps/03-propose-loop.md ("Required output — two layers")
# update the two lists below in the same commit. tests/unit/propose-golden.bats enforces the match.

## ALLOWED — the only fields that may be printed to the user at the gate
Recommendation
Impact
Options
Assumed
Open
Ask

## FORBIDDEN — moved to the plan artifact; printing these to the user is the regression
Implementation steps
Test plan
Serena rules
Lite critic
Converged plan
Test backlog
Test design dossier
Critique trail
Vault writes
Index updates

## FORBIDDEN — panel vocabulary; translate to plain words before it reaches the user
BLOCKER
MAJOR
advisory
grounding
persona
convergence
rounds
dedupe
fan-out
disposition

## ALWAYS-EMITTED — exceptions that survive the omit-when-empty rule
research: unavailable
safe-default
open blocker
capped with N open blockers
minority flag
